profile.headline: Experienced lead software engineer/architect with diverse expertise in software development, architecture and project management
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with the following skill sets:
Programming Languages: Java, Python
J2EE/Web: React,Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, AJAX, Asynchronous REST, SOAP, Jackson, Jaxb, JSON, XML
RDBMS/NoSQL: SQL, PL/SQL, MySQL, MongoDb, DynamoDB
Cloud Technologies: AWS Architecture, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, Athena, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, Docker containers etc
Source code/Version control: Git, Git Bash, TortoiseGit, SourceTree
Server Environment: Linux/Unix, Windows Testing: JUnit, PowerMock, EasyMock, Mockito Software Methodologies: AGILE, SCRUM, KANBAN
Web Server: Tomcat, Oracle Weblogic Server, Oracle Weblogic Portal, IBM websphere
Tools: Eclipse, IBM RTC, NotePad++, SOAP UI, POSTMAN
Documentation: Analysis document, High-level & Low-level design document, Test-plan document and
application “How To” document.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in all phases of SDLC for Precision Health Initiative project
Designed, architected and implemented complex ETL applications with coordinating and managing various Clinical and Genomic data coming from different sources.
Developed applications with a variety of languages and frameworks like JAVA, Python, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, JdbcTemplate, REST, SQL, PL/SQL.
Worked in AGILE/SCRUMBAN developing environment.
Conducted benchmark tests for the applications and actively participated in the QualityAssurance process of development.
Implemented Healthcare applications for clinical and genomic data using HL7, FHIRAPI Developed various python and shell scripts in the various phases on ETL pipeline.
Mapped various healthcare codes to standard SNOMED, CPT, ICD9, ICD10, LOINC codes. Excelled in rapid application development and management of technological issues, earning the highest customersatisfaction rating for all software solutions delivered.
Developed complexpatient matching applications for patients coming from several sources Implemented several Unit and Integrationtests to ensure application functionalities, performance and efficiency
Developed CI/CD pipelines using Atlasssian Bitbucket and Bamboo.
Implemented FHIR terminology service from scratch.
Working with AWS ECS,ECR,CloudWatch,S3,Route 53,ELB etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in several phases of SDLC like requirement gathering, analysis, design, implementation and testing.
Implemented Accenture Public Service Platform building several REST based services utilizing Service Oriented Architecture and implementing various 3rd party APIs.
Leveraged AWS for building services using Lambda, EC2, APIGateway and RDS.
Designed and implemented complexapplication services and APIs and consolidated within Accenture's platform.
Constantly developing Unit, Integration and Regression tests for product Quality and efficiency
Utilized SonarQube and OWASP to ensure product quality and security
Worked in AGILE/SCRUM development environment
Developed CI/CD development pipelines using Jenkins
Constantly engaged with customers for their requirements and delivered efficient software solutions to customers
Used JUnit, Mockito, EasyMock, PowerMock for unit testing applications

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
• Involved in application design, development and testing, while integrating new application to the existing ones. 
• Leveraged Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) to build multiple independent clients who can make HTTP
requests using RESTful web services build on top of Spring MVC.
• Utilized "Agile" process to streamline development process with iterative development and TTD.
• Trained and involved in using frameworks such as Spring, Struts, Hibernate, JDBC, SOAP, REST, WSDL
and implemented same while developing web services and web applications.
• Used Java Messaging Services (JMS Active MQ) for reliable and asynchronous exchange of important
information such as Service Level Agreements.
• Wrote persistence layer and business layer for the application using ORM (Object Relational Mapping)
technologies such as Spring JDBC, Hibernate.
• Used MySQL and PL/SQL to create and perform queries on database.
• Built robust directives using Angular JS to extend HTML, also leveraged angular to implement MVC
architecture in the front end.
• Used front end technologies like JavaScript, Ajax, HTML, CSS, JQuery, Angular JS to build robust web application.
• Designed Sequence, Use Case Diagrams and Process Flow Diagrams to convert business requirements into
technical designs.
• Actively involved in getting the production and testing issues resolved by closely working with testing and
support teams.
• Extensively worked on maven build tool for building and deploying applications.
• Worked to improve the unit test coverage of the application by writing unit test cases using mock frameworks such as EasyMock, Mockito, PowerMock.
